headline: Scientific Analog joins Accellera Systems Initiative
fact: Scientific Analog announces that it joined Accellera Systems Initiative as of January 15, 2022. Its January 18 announcement connects participation to its SystemVerilog analog-verification products and interoperability goals. Accellera’s August 2022 newsletter independently welcomes Scientific Analog among new members. Membership alone does not establish a particular working-group contribution, standard release, or customer adoption.

sources.title: Scientific Analog Joins Accellera
sources.summary: The January 18 announcement explicitly gives January 15, 2022 as the membership effective date.

sources.title: Accellera Community Newsletter: August 2022
sources.summary: Accellera welcomes Scientific Analog among its newest members; it does not identify specific technical contributions.
